documents.list.addToTestSet.disabledHint.defaultMessage: Select at least one document that has finished processing
documents.list.addToTestSet.disabledHint.description: Tooltip of the Add to test set button when no selected document can be added.

documents.list.addToTestSet.enabledHint.defaultMessage: Add the selected documents to a test set
documents.list.addToTestSet.enabledHint.description: Tooltip of the Add to test set button when it can be used.

documents.list.addToTestSet.label.description: Document List toolbar button that adds the selected documents to a Test Studio test set.

i18n.switcher.ariaLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the language menu button. {language} is the current language by its own name, e.g. "English".

i18n.switcher.label.description: Tooltip of the language menu button in the top navigation. The button itself shows the current language by its own name (English, Français (Canada)).

pricing.layout.cannotSaveInvalidPrices.defaultMessage: Cannot save: {count, plural, one {# price is} other {# prices are}} not valid. Correct the prices listed under Invalid prices and save again.
pricing.layout.cannotSaveInvalidPrices.description: Error shown when Save changes is chosen on the Pricing page while some prices are invalid. {count} is how many.

pricing.layout.defaultUnitsAlwaysApply.defaultMessage: Your saved prices are applied over the default prices. A default unit you delete comes back at its default price after you save and reload. To make a default unit cost nothing, set its price to 0.
pricing.layout.defaultUnitsAlwaysApply.description: Note above the pricing tables on the Pricing page: deleting a default unit does not persist, because saved prices are merged over the defaults per unit.

pricing.layout.invalidPrice.defaultMessage: Enter a non-negative decimal number with no spaces, such as 0.0015 or 6.0E-8.
pricing.layout.invalidPrice.description: Inline error under a price field on the Pricing page when the value is not a valid price.

pricing.layout.invalidPriceItem.defaultMessage: {apiName} / {unitName}: "{price}" is not a valid price. Use a non-negative decimal number with no spaces, such as 0.0015 or 6.0E-8.
pricing.layout.invalidPriceItem.description: One line in the list of invalid prices on the Pricing page. {apiName} is the service/API name, {unitName} the unit name, {price} the value as typed.

pricing.layout.invalidPricesHeader.description: Header of the warning that lists every price on the Pricing page that cannot be saved.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.notComp.defaultMessage: Only documents that finished processing can be added to a test set.
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.notComp.description: Body of the notice about selected documents that are left out.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.notComp.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# selected document is not included} other {# selected documents are not included}}
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.notComp.description: Header of a notice listing selected documents that are left out because they have not finished processing.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.pickerH.defaultMessage: Add documents to a test set
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.pickerH.description: Header of the add-to-test-set dialog opened from the Document List, before a test set is chosen.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.pickerI.defaultMessage: Each selected document is copied into the test set together with any ground truth already saved for it. One without ground truth is added unlabeled, so it can be draft-labeled in Test Studio afterwards. Documents already in the set are skipped, so labels reviewed there are kept.
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.pickerI.description: Introduction of the add-to-test-set dialog opened from the Document List, where the documents are already chosen.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.selecte.description: Header of the table listing the documents chosen on the Document List.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.testSet.defaultMessage: The documents are added to an existing test set. To start a new set, create it in Test Studio first.
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.testSet.description: Help text under the test set field in the add-to-test-set dialog.
Description of a test set option: how many documents the set already holds.
Label of the field that chooses which test set the selected documents are added to.
Placeholder of the test set field before one is chosen.
Why a test set option cannot be chosen. {status} is the test set status, such as UPDATING.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.testSet.defaultMessage: There are no test sets yet. Create one in Test Studio first.
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.testSet.description: Shown in the test set field when no test set exists.
Error shown when the list of test sets fails to load. {error} is the error message from the server.
Shown in the test set field while the list of test sets loads.

testStudio.itemEdit.regroupPending.description: Why Edit Page Grouping is unavailable: a page grouping was just saved and the document editor is still re-reading the saved sections.

testStudio.itemEdit.regroupRereadFailed.defaultMessage: The saved grouping could not be re-read. Choose Refresh to load it.
testStudio.itemEdit.regroupRereadFailed.description: Why Edit Page Grouping is unavailable: re-reading the sections after a page grouping was saved failed. Refresh is a button on the same page.
